name: GeoServer
about: The newest GeoServer release on the stable and maintenance lines, plus the last 2.27 release, which is end-of-life.

lines.note: Stable line. GeoServer announced 3.0.2 on 19 Oct 2026; its GitHub release is dated 17 Oct.
Maintenance line. GeoServer announced 2.28.6 on 19 Oct 2026; its GitHub release is dated 2 Nov.

End-of-life. GeoServer says 2.27.7 was issued to address an urgent bug or security vulnerability, to apply it as a mitigation only, and to plan a move to 2.28 or 3.0. Announced 19 Oct 2026; its GitHub release is dated 18 Oct.

older: GeoServer 2.26 and older are end-of-life and get no fixes: move to 3.0 or 2.28.

sources.title: GeoServer downloads: 3.0.2 stable, 2.28.6 maintenance, 2.27 and older archived
